Sam Ops: Quick note 7: Company all-hands scheduled for Tue 8:30 AM PT. Posting agenda + Q&A flow below — hybrid, recording ON.

Omar - Product: Draft agenda (30min):
```
8:30-8:38: CEO update (Rina)
8:38-8:48: Product launches + Dedicated GA callouts (Omar)
8:48-8:54: Reliability & incident recap (Leah)
8:54-9:00: Customer highlights & pilots (Ben)
9:00-9:10: Live Q&A (panel)
```

Leah SRE: For the incident recap I'll show a short timeline and 2 charts (5xx rate & p99 latency). I'll attach slides by Monday EOD.

Ben Sales: We have 2 pilots asking about the GA migration path and support SLAs. Can Product include a one-slide migration FAQ?

Omar - Product: Yep 1 adding migration FAQ + CLI snippet for migration. Will demo Optimize recs for a typical mid-market workload (2-3 min).

Rina (CEO): Ill cover company strategy, the new policy update (hosted logs retention defaults moving to 90d opt-out, and clearer telemetry opt-ins for enterprise), and our FY outlook. We'll keep it tight.

Sam Ops: Logistics: calendar invite has meet link (join in calendar). Recording will be available. Please add Qs to the shared doc: https://docs.internal/allhands/qna and mark as `live` if you want to ask live.

Ben Sales: Will the recording include a 1-page executive takeaway? Customers ask for that.

Sam Ops: Yes 1 recording + 1-pager recap within 24 hours.

Leah SRE: Small ask: ops wants a short note on the mitigations we pushed and the follow-up RCA timeframe. Ill include a slide with follow-up owners.

Rina (CEO): Also going to make a brief ask to engineering: prioritization of auto-fallbacks for model variants in the next quarter. Noted in the slides.

notify-bot: Reminder posted to #all-hands and invites sent. :bell:

Sam Ops: Action items: 1) Leads -> one-slide callouts (customer/pilot/RCA) by Mon EOD. 2) SRE -> attach charts by Mon EOD. 3) Product -> final deck + demo script by Mon EOD. 4) Ops -> publish recording + 1-pager within 24h post-meeting.
